title: Chapter 1480 - 16: Beyond Transcendence (Grand Finale) (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 1480 - 16: Beyond Transcendence (Grand Finale) (Part 3)

Chapter 1480: Chapter 16: Beyond Transcendence (Grand Finale) (Part 3)

For instance, in the numerous previous reincarnations, Lin Yuan reached the end and similarly faced obstruction from the will of the Supreme Rule Dao, summoning various terrifying beings from the past and future to confront him.

In those reincarnations, Lin Yuan generally couldn’t resist; he could only abandon his tribe, hometown, family, friends, and transform all his anger and unwillingness into the motivation for cultivation.

This was also intentional by Lin Yuan.

The path of cultivation cannot always be smooth; it requires external pressure and challenges.

Therefore, in the earliest reincarnations, Lin Yuan’s lives were extremely tragic, often with parents killed by enemies in his early years, hometown resources plundered, and himself pursued and hunted.

There were too many instances.

It was under these pressures that Lin Yuan could walk a more perfect path.

As for this reincarnation... With the foundation formed from the previous thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-two reincarnations, even if Lin Yuan tried his best to weaken himself, it was difficult to achieve because his cultivation speed was too fast; often before enemies could make a move, Lin Yuan had already far surpassed them.

For example, in the original world where the six Ancient Countries reside, Lin Yuan was initially supposed to stand in opposition to the six ancestors and be hunted by these six Perfect Time Beings.

But Lin Yuan’s rapid growth scared the ancestors with future timelines, prompting them to choose to befriend and strengthen connections regardless of anything.

...

In the thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three reincarnations, the major events were roughly the same, but there were still slight differences in details.

Just like the number of reincarnations, in the thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-third reincarnation, the essence of the endless dimensional realms was related to the number thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three.

Whereas in the eleven thousand one hundred and eleventh reincarnation, the essence of the endless dimensional realms was related to the number eleven thousand one hundred and eleven.

...

The entire endless dimensional realm was personally created by Lin Yuan, and the will of the Supreme Rule Dao was also a piece of ’spirit’ casually refined by Lin Yuan to maintain the operation of the endless dimensional realm.

As for the ’infinite tribulation’ path of transcendence? Those Legendary Lords believed that overcoming all tribulations meant transcendence, but it wasn’t true. Even if you really traversed the ’infinite tribulation’ path, all you would get is a promise from the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

It could allow the will of the Supreme Rule Dao to take action to help him do one thing.

In past reincarnation eras, Lin Yuan’s reincarnation body grew slowly, including enemies who had walked the ’infinite tribulation’ path and made demands to the will of the Supreme Rule Dao—to erase Lin Yuan’s existence.

The will of the Supreme Rule Dao personally took action, which for Lin Yuan was an unprecedented desperate situation, ultimately exhausting all World-Breaking Origin Force to barely survive.

In the thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-third reincarnation, Lin Yuan’s growth speed did not even give enemies this opportunity.

And the ’infinite origin’ path to transcendence? Actually, it cannot transcend, because the so-called source of time is precisely where Lin Yuan’s true body slumbers, and no being in the endless dimensional realm can possibly approach here. Even if they got close, they would be immediately erased.

The final Perfect Time Being... The leap from the thirteenth stage to transcendence is indeed too great; Lin Yuan once went through countless tribulations to become a transcender, until now reaching the pinnacle of transcenders.

With just one reincarnation era, trying to give birth to another transcender? It’s not possible at all.

...

"In this reincarnation era, my growth was indeed too smooth."

Lin Yuan reflected for a moment, shaking his head slightly; compared to many previous reincarnation bodies, he almost encountered no significant hardships or challenges; family and friends were intact.

The reason lies in his growth being too fast, so fast that it didn’t even allow the prearranged hardships and challenges the conditions to arise.

...

"The accumulation is perfect, ready to break through."

Lin Yuan’s gaze gradually became solemn; before starting the thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-third reincarnation era, he was already at the pinnacle of transcenders.

And after experiencing so many reincarnations, each reincarnation was a different path, accumulating the foundation to perfection, making the breakthrough a natural, logical progression.

"Beyond transcendence? None have reached it yet..."

Lin Yuan felt his own transformation; in fact, after awakening, with perfect accumulation, he was already naturally beginning to transform.

Outside the endless dimensional realms is the vast world where Lin Yuan resides, where transcenders are also supreme beings, very few in number.

Buzzing ~ As the transformation constantly proceeds, Lin Yuan’s spirit swiftly elevates, breaking free from all constraints, finally touching a brand new domain.

"Beyond transcendence... is reality, absolute reality..."

After breaking free from all constraints and bonds, a true domain more incredible than the vast world he resides in appeared within Lin Yuan’s perception.

"Reality..."

Lin Yuan was radiant.

Then he flipped his right hand, tearing open the vast world and leapt into the realm of reality.

(The End of the Book)

(There will be an epilogue and extras later)
